name: Yolo County, California (United States)
description: Tan field with a dark blue stripe along the top bearing the words YOLO COUNTY and a brown stripe along the bottom bearing the date 1850, charged at the centre with a woman in white holding a sheaf of wheat.
history: Yolo County is a county in the northern portion of California; Flags of the World records the flag in use by 2001, with a brighter version in use by 2015.

features.role: female figure with a sheaf of wheat
